cypher: MATCH (b)-[:blocks*1..10]->(x {id: '{X}'}) RETURN DISTINCT b.id AS id ORDER BY id
MATCH (x {id: '{X}'})<-[:blocks*1..10]-(b) RETURN DISTINCT b.id AS id ORDER BY id

MATCH p = (a)-[:blocks*1..10]->(z) WHERE NOT EXISTS { MATCH ()-[:blocks]->(a) } AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (z)-[:blocks]->() } UNWIND nodes(p) AS n RETURN n.id AS id, count(*) AS chains ORDER BY chains DESC, id LIMIT 5

MATCH (a)-[:blocks*0..10]->(n)-[:blocks*0..10]->(z) WHERE NOT EXISTS { MATCH ()-[:blocks]->(a) } AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (z)-[:blocks]->() } AND a <> z RETURN n.id AS id, count(*) AS chains ORDER BY chains DESC, id LIMIT 5

MATCH (a)-[:blocks*0..10]->(n)-[:blocks*0..10]->(z) WHERE NOT EXISTS { MATCH ()-[:blocks]->(a) } AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (z)-[:blocks]->() } AND a <> z RETURN n.id AS id, count(*) AS chains ORDER BY chains DESC, id LIMIT 5
MATCH (q:question) WHERE q.status IN ['open', 'proposed'] AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (q)<-[:answers]-() } RETURN q.id AS id ORDER BY id
MATCH (a:decision)-[:conflicts_with]-(b:decision) WHERE a.id < b.id RETURN a.id AS a, b.id AS b ORDER BY a, b
MATCH (a:decision)-[:conflicts_with]-(b:decision) WHERE a.id < b.id RETURN a.id AS src, b.id AS dst ORDER BY src, dst
MATCH (n) WHERE size(n.evidence_kinds) > 0 AND all(k IN n.evidence_kinds WHERE k = 'analyst') RETURN n.id AS id ORDER BY id
MATCH (n) WHERE size(n.evidence_kinds) > 0 AND NOT 'client' IN n.evidence_kinds AND NOT 'transcript' IN n.evidence_kinds RETURN n.id AS id ORDER BY id
MATCH (x {id: '{A}'})-[r]-(n) RETURN label(r) AS rel, n.id AS id ORDER BY rel, id
MATCH (x {id: '{A}'})-[r]-(n) RETURN type(r) AS rel, n.id AS id ORDER BY rel, id
MATCH (x {id: '{A}'})-[:blocks]-(n) RETURN DISTINCT 'blocks' AS rel, n.id AS id ORDER BY rel, id
MATCH (a)-[r:supports]->(b) WHERE r.confidence > 0.5 RETURN a.id AS src, b.id AS dst, r.confidence AS c ORDER BY src, dst
MATCH (a)-[r:supports]->(b) WHERE r.confidence_pct > 50 RETURN a.id AS src, b.id AS dst, r.confidence_pct AS c ORDER BY src, dst
MATCH p = (a {id: '{A}'})-[* SHORTEST 1..10]-(b {id: '{B}'}) RETURN length(p) AS hops
MATCH p = shortestPath((a {id: '{A}'})-[*..10]-(b {id: '{B}'})) RETURN length(p) AS hops
MATCH (n)-[r]-() RETURN n.id AS id, count(r) AS degree ORDER BY degree DESC, id LIMIT 10
MATCH (n)--(m) RETURN n.id AS id, count(*) AS degree ORDER BY degree DESC, id LIMIT 10
MATCH (n)--(m) RETURN n.id AS id, count(*) AS degree ORDER BY degree DESC, id LIMIT 10
MATCH (x {id: '{X2}'})-[:depends_on*2..2]->(t) RETURN DISTINCT t.id AS id ORDER BY id
CREATE (n:question {id: 'Q-x'}) RETURN n
MERGE (n:question {id: 'Q-x'}) RETURN n
MATCH (n {id: '{A}'}) SET n.status = 'x' RETURN n.id
MATCH (n:decision) RETURN n.id AS id UNION MATCH (n:question) RETURN n.id AS id
MATCH (n {id: $id}) RETURN n.id
CALL show_tables() RETURN *
MATCH (n:decision:question) RETURN n.id
MATCH (a)-[:`depends-on`]->(b) RETURN a.id
MATCH (a)-[:nope]->(b) RETURN a.id
MATCH (a:decision) RETURN a.nope LIMIT 1
MATCH (a)-[r:supports]->(b) RETURN r LIMIT 1
